title: Semiconductor Yield Optimization & Defect Detection
thesis: Snowflake detects yield degradation across 12 fabs, classifies wafer defects with AI, forecasts equipment failures, and alerts engineers — all native SQL, no external ML platform needed

talking_points: Two hundred million ringgit in annual yield loss across 12 fabs in the Penang-Kulim corridor.
Four fabs are below target yield — FAB-002, FAB-005, FAB-008, and FAB-011.
Seventeen equipment alarms in the last 48 hours.
show: Point at the RM 200M yield loss KPI card
tabs.call_out: RM 200M yield loss — 4 of 12 fabs CRITICAL

transition.line: Let's drill into which fabs are degrading and why.

talking_points: FAB-002 running Intel's 7nm node — yield at 83.4%, thirteen points below target.
Defect Pareto shows Particle contamination driving 42% of failures.
ML.ANOMALY_DETECTION confirms: 7 of the last 14 days anomalous for FAB-002.
show: Click FAB-002 in the fab list
Show the yield trend with anomaly markers
tabs.call_out: 7 of 14 days anomalous — systematic, not random

transition.line: The yield is broken. Let's see if equipment telemetry explains why.

talking_points: Seventeen alarms in 48 hours. ML.FORECAST predicts three tools will exceed failure threshold within 72 hours.
EQ-0047 — the ASML lithography tool in FAB-002 — chamber pressure spiking.
Snowflake connects equipment drift to yield loss to defect type — one query, one platform.
show: Point at equipment alarm table sorted by severity
Show correlation: pressure spikes match yield drops
tabs.call_out: 3 tools predicted to fail within 72 hours — ML.FORECAST

transition.line: Now let the VP ask the system directly.

talking_points: Dr. Tan doesn't write SQL. She asks: 'Which fab has the highest yield loss in ringgit?'
Cortex Analyst writes the query, returns the answer: FAB-002, RM 47M.
Switch to advisor: 'What corrective actions for FAB-002?' — searches process docs and recommends.
show: Type: 'Which fab has the highest yield loss in MYR?'
tabs.call_out: Two AI modes: SQL analytics + strategic advisory

talking_points: Eight Snowflake capabilities, six AWS services.
In Snowflake-only mode — Cortex Complete replaces Bedrock, ML functions replace SageMaker.
Malaysia's semiconductor industry: RM 450 billion. This monitors 12 fabs, 120 tools, 5,000 lots.
tabs.call_out: One platform, native SQL, open Iceberg

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — better together for semiconductor manufacturing.
